name: jqml4
description: Syntax highlighting, completions, navigation and live diagnostics for JQML 4

jqml4.configPath.description: Path to a JQML compiler JSON config with dirs/includes. Absolute path, ${workspaceFolder} and ${env:NAME} are supported.

jqml4.env.description: Variables used for ${NAME} placeholders in the compiler config. They override the process environment.

jqml4.importPaths.description: Folders searched for <Module>/qmldir to resolve `import Module 1.0`. ${workspaceFolder} and ${env:NAME} are supported.

jqml4.enginePath.description: Optional root of the JQML v4 sources (the folder with src/items.js). Used to open the source of built-in types on Go to Definition. Empty: the folder this extension was built from.

jqml4.hideInternalMembers.description: Hide names that start with an underscore from completions.

jqml4.diagnostics.unknownTypes.description: Warn about types that are neither built in nor found through imports.

jqml4.diagnostics.unknownMembers.description: Warn about properties and signal handlers that the type does not declare.
